recent_campaigns.name: Azerbaijani Oil and Gas Industry Targeting
recent_campaigns.description: In May 2026, Bitdefender published a report describing Salt Typhoon/FamousSparrow targeting Azerbaijani oil and gas industry. The campagin, lasting between late December 2025 through late February 2026, exploited Microsoft Exchange server entry point vulnerability to deploy "two distinct backdoor families, Deed RAT and Terndoor."

sources.title: FamousSparrow APT Targets Azerbaijani Oil and Gas Industry

recent_campaigns.name: US Treasury Department Breach (Silk Typhoon / BeyondTrust)
recent_campaigns.description: In what became APT27's most high-profile operation, actors linked to Silk Typhoon/APT27 (subsequently identified as Yin Kecheng) compromised BeyondTrust's Remote Support SaaS platform beginning around September 2024. The breach, discovered by BeyondTrust on December 2, 2024, affected over 3,000 unclassified files across approximately 100 Treasury computers. Compromised offices included the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) — which administers US sanctions — and the Office of Financial Research. Files related to senior officials including Secretary Janet Yellen and Deputy Secretary Wally Adeyemo were reportedly compromised. The targeting of OFAC is particularly significant given China's strategic interest in understanding and potentially circumventing US sanctions enforcement. Microsoft published a concurrent report linking Silk Typhoon to IT supply chain targeting and an Ivanti VPN zero-day (CVE-2025-0282). Yin Kecheng was sanctioned in January 2025; both Yin and Zhou Shuai were indicted in March 2025.

sources.title: Chinese Nationals with Ties to the PRC Government and 'APT27' Charged
Treasury Sanctions Chinese Hacker Associated with Treasury Compromise

recent_campaigns.name: COVID-19 Vaccine Research Espionage
recent_campaigns.description: Beginning in February 2020 as the pandemic emerged, HAFNIUM operators targeted American universities conducting COVID-19 vaccine research. The U.S. DOJ indictment stated this campaign was aimed at "stealing groundbreaking COVID-19 research" on behalf of the CCP.

sources.title: DOJ Indictment — Xu Zewei and Zhang Yu

recent_campaigns.name: Cloud Providers Campaign
recent_campaigns.description: Since 2023, CrowdStrike observed HAFNIUM/Murky Panda targeting cloud environment,  "likely motivated by intelligence-collection requirements to gain access to sensitive information." CrowdStrike described the adversary as "cloud-conscious," for its abilities to operate in cloud environment.

sources.title: MURKY PANDA: A Trusted-Relationship Threat in the Cloud

recent_campaigns.name: IT Supply Chain Campaign
recent_campaigns.description: Microsoft documented HAFNIUM/Silk Typhoon's shift toward IT supply chain targeting, compromising IT services providers, RMM companies, and MSPs to reach downstream customer environments. The group used stolen API keys, compromised OAuth applications, and service principal abuse for lateral movement and data exfiltration. Victims included state and local government, IT services, and financial institutions.

sources.title: Silk Typhoon Targeting IT Supply Chain
